title: Finally releasing the public repo / demo of my game
author: Potential-Bend7214
selftext:
finally, after weeks of pain and development with ai, I have finally finished my game:

Overworked - a Simulator version 7.5

  
OVERWORKED: A Corporate Work Simulator

[](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked#overworked-a-corporate-work-simulator)

**Overworked** is a satirical corporate work simulator web application. The player assumes the role of a junior "Operational Data & Compliance Analyst" at a mega-corporation (*OmniCorp Enterprise Systems*). The goal of the game is to survive a "standard workday" while navigating increasingly absurd, contradictory, passive-aggressive corporate bureaucracy, broken enterprise software, and especially infuriating, annoying colleagues and a micromanaging boss.

# Features

[](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked#features)

* **OmniOS Desktop Workspace**: A dense, dark-themed enterprise desktop suite mimicking Windows, Teams, Zoom, and Excel.
* **SyncTalk (Chat Desk)**: Branching dialogues with coworkers (Brad, Karen, Chad, Priya, Derek, and Greg) featuring unhelpful responses, passive-aggressive remarks, and sudden demands.
* **MeetStream (Zoom Simulator)**: Click-to-progress audio-less video call engine with non-skippable slides, closed captions, and sudden interactive check-ins.
* **DataGrid (Spreadsheet Workbench)**: Reconcile financial data while avoiding hidden validation traps, volatile formulas, and trailing whitespaces.
* **System Obstacles**: Deal with password rotations, 2FA modals, disk defragmentation lockouts, standing desk height calibration, and quarantine updates.
* **Synthesized Corporate Sounds**: Custom chimes programmatically generated via browser Web Audio API for message pings, notifications, call joins, and task additions (zero-asset overhead).

# Local Development & Setup

[](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked#local-development--setup)

# Prerequisites

[](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked#prerequisites)

* Node.js (v16+) installed.

# Setup and Launch

[](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked#setup-and-launch)

1. Clone or extract the project directory.
2. Install local proxy dependencies:npm install
3. Run the AI proxy server:node server.js *(Alternatively, run* `start.bat` *on Windows to install dependencies and run the server automatically).*
4. Navigate to [`http://localhost:3001`](http://localhost:3001) in your browser to play the game!

# Public Deployment

[](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked#public-deployment)

The application is pre-configured to be hosted directly on the web:

* **Render**: Connect your GitHub repository as a **Web Service** running `node server.js`.
* **Cloudflare Pages**: Connect your GitHub repository as a **Pages** application. Cloudflare will automatically build the static assets and deploy the backend `/api/chat` and `/health`endpoints using the edge handlers inside the `functions/` folder.

  
if you have any questions about my workflow, what I use, etc, just ask in the comments or DM me. Also, feel free to try and break the game.

  
public site: [https://overworked.onrender.com](https://overworked.onrender.com)

Repo: [https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked](https://github.com/blankCanvasStudios/OverWorked)

  
I don’t give consent to take the files and claim it as yours with or without credit, but if you ask to alter them or try and add some things, sure! Just let me see them when you’re done, and don’t publish it as your own work.

(yes, I am aware that the current version says version 7.0 at the bottom. Ik it’s 7.5, but at the moment the ai is exhausted and so am I)

  
thanks!

comments.author: sw3d
comments.body: I had a similar idea with [https://9001.games/whitecollar](https://9001.games/whitecollar)

replies.author: Potential-Bend7214
replies.body: wow—that website is pretty good in my opinion. the emojis could be toned down and some symbols are off scales / misplaced, but overall I think it perfectly mimics the old windows format. our ideas are really similar!

replies.author: sw3d
replies.body: Check out some of the menus, there's lots of Easter eggs if you feel nostalgia for the old windows experience. You can even use a browser or play solitaire inside the sim. Giving overworked a try now :)

replies.author: Potential-Bend7214
replies.body: thanks for trying it out. I’ll make sure to check out those Easter eggs, I look forward to them, also the other minigames on the main page are very creative and seem fun for the younger audience, which is great :\]

replies.author: sw3d
replies.body: Thanks :) actually a lot of these were made together with my daughter, she designed a few herself on paper including [https://9001.games/scoop](https://9001.games/scoop)

replies.author: Potential-Bend7214
replies.body: your welcome. I tried out the scoops game, it seemed pretty fun. it’s so nice how your daughter designed it. I look forward to further development for the website, and im lwk very impressed by how you managed the graphics so well, since usual coding models aren’t good at graphics (try meshy and Rodin for 3d models)

replies.author: sw3d
replies.body:
Graphics were a combination of source material (screenshots of daughter's drawings or my sketches) + grinding it out :) 

Agree that the models aren't great at making 3D or even 2D assets, but you can push them to do it through iteration/incremental improvement.

replies.author: Potential-Bend7214
replies.body: yeah, I agree, Im pretty sure, bc of some tests i tried out, the models can have some good graphic assets if you push it enough, although the sources such as your daughter’s sketches are also part of its development, which is great ofc

comments.author: sw3d
comments.body: I did a playthrough; I feel like this has potential but could use some more variety in the visuals; I was excited to see "MeetStream" and assumed there would be some funny videos in there of my boring boss droning on about something, but sadly it was not there. Without something like that, the UX is very dry. I'm also wondering if more of an onboarding phase could help with the world-building / getting the player to care about the game before dropping them in (something I also struggeld with in whitecollar - I feel like its nice to get some laughs out of the older crowd who remembers the UX, but didnt have enough of a hook to really make it meaningful)

replies.author: Potential-Bend7214
replies.body:
here is my reply on your suggestions and overall review: 

by onboarding, do you mean, like for example (some ideas I have) cutscenes before the real game begins? if so, I think that idea is great, I was thinking about it at the beginning but eventually gave up on doing. I think that could really help with the game, I might do it. I can Dm you or reply in this thread to let u know once I updated the game

i absolutely agree with your suggestions about the visuals. personally i feel like coding ai models, like Claude or Gemini, don’t exactly specialize in making visuals in games and normal sites. I tried meshy and Rodin before, but that didn’t work out well since I didn’t use the paid plan just yet or needed 3d models. so sometimes I decide to hand-draw them since im an artist and don’t support ai “art.” 

Oh yeah, about the meetstream. I planned it to be something like Zoom, so sadly im not so sure about including videos of the boss like a storage of recordings or something (did I misunderstand it?). 

overall I appreciate the thoughtful feedback, I’ll work on my game and try including some of your suggestions, and keep up the good work with 9001 Games.

replies.author: sw3d
replies.body:
Add me in DM, but yeah onboarding cutscenes before the real game, to set up more of a "vibe"

MeetStream: I think it has an opportunity to present something more than text/documents to the experience, but Im not sure whats the best format; to throw out some ideas, it could be a silly hand-drawn stick figure video, an AI-generated video that is intentionally bad (as a gag)

replies.author: Potential-Bend7214
replies.body: noted! I’ll try and do the cutscenes part, not so sure abt the meetstream thing, tho. I’ll DM you once it’s done.
